title: Add an asset to the register
summary: Register assets from paid bills, or add one by hand.

steps.text: Open {fa} from the sidebar to see every registered asset.
Click {intake} to register an asset from a paid bill's lines, or {add} to add one by hand.
You can also ask the assistant to add an asset, take one in from a bill line or update an asset's details. It shows each change as a card and makes it only when you confirm.
